items.details: Stay with the convoy during its travel sections and use the Lost badge when the formation tutorial introduces it. Riding over the badge restores health and repairs the motorcycle; it is useful recovery rather than a racing checkpoint. In the scrapyard fight, keep space from explosive barrels and use cover before collecting the fallen enemies' ammunition. Finish the ride back with Billy instead of leaving as soon as his bike is recovered.

details_i18n.en: Stay with the convoy during its travel sections and use the Lost badge when the formation tutorial introduces it. Riding over the badge restores health and repairs the motorcycle; it is useful recovery rather than a racing checkpoint. In the scrapyard fight, keep space from explosive barrels and use cover before collecting the fallen enemies' ammunition. Finish the ride back with Billy instead of leaving as soon as his bike is recovered.
details_i18n.pt: Fique com o comboio nos trajetos e use o emblema Lost quando o tutorial de formação apresentá-lo. Passar sobre o emblema recupera vida e conserta a moto; é um recurso de recuperação, não um checkpoint de corrida. No tiroteio do ferro-velho, mantenha distância dos barris explosivos e use cobertura antes de recolher a munição dos inimigos. Termine o retorno com Billy, sem sair assim que recuperar a moto dele.

items.details: Johnny's escape route goes downstairs after the interrupted deal. Do not follow instructions for Niko's separate version of the same event, which takes a different route. Clear the immediate attackers from cover, work down through the building and reach the street. The job is not finished merely by leaving the apartment: lose the police search before considering the mission complete.

details_i18n.en: Johnny's escape route goes downstairs after the interrupted deal. Do not follow instructions for Niko's separate version of the same event, which takes a different route. details_i18n.pt: A rota de fuga de Johnny desce as escadas após a negociação interrompida. Não siga instruções da versão separada desse acontecimento com Niko, que usa outro trajeto. Elimine os atacantes próximos usando cobertura, desça pelo prédio e alcance a rua. Sair do apartamento não encerra o trabalho: escape da busca policial antes de considerar a missão concluída.

items.details: Calling Terry or Clay for backup gives you help at the rear of the property. An explosive fired through the indicated window can force the occupants out, but it changes how you approach the confrontation. If you want the opportunity to spare Brian and see his later encounter, use an approach that leaves him alive until the decision. His conditional encounter is not required for native 100%, so either story decision remains valid.

details_i18n.en: Calling Terry or Clay for backup gives you help at the rear of the property. An explosive fired through the indicated window can force the occupants out, but it changes how you approach the confrontation. If you want the opportunity to spare Brian and see his later encounter, use an approach that leaves him alive until the decision. His conditional encounter is not required for native 100%, so either story decision remains valid.
details_i18n.pt: Chamar Terry ou Clay como reforço oferece ajuda na parte traseira do imóvel. Um explosivo lançado pela janela indicada pode expulsar os ocupantes, mas muda a abordagem do confronto. Se quiser a oportunidade de poupar Brian e ver o encontro posterior, use uma abordagem que o mantenha vivo até a decisão. Esse encontro condicional não é exigido para os 100% nativos; qualquer decisão da história continua válida.

items.details: Johnny shoots from the back of Malc's bike while Malc handles the route. Use the supplied unlimited ammunition to stop close pursuers quickly, checking both behind and ahead as the threats change. At the blocked showroom section, clear the officers and shoot the windows to open the escape route. When the weapon changes to pipe bombs, time releases for the pursuing cars rather than dropping every explosive at the same distance.

details_i18n.en: Johnny shoots from the back of Malc's bike while Malc handles the route. Use the supplied unlimited ammunition to stop close pursuers quickly, checking both behind and ahead as the threats change. At the blocked showroom section, clear the officers and shoot the windows to open the escape route. details_i18n.pt: Johnny atira da garupa da moto de Malc, que controla o trajeto. Use a munição ilimitada fornecida para deter os perseguidores próximos, conferindo a frente e a retaguarda conforme as ameaças mudam. No trecho bloqueado da concessionária, elimine os policiais e atire nas janelas para abrir a fuga. Quando a arma mudar para bombas caseiras, ajuste o lançamento à distância dos carros, em vez de soltar todos os explosivos da mesma maneira.

items.details: At the prison, speak to Terry before starting the assault: his weapon stock is free during this mission. Bring a rifle and explosives, open the gate and clear each area from cover. Watch raised walkways and rooftop shooters before advancing with the crew. Use the health and armor pickups when needed, then finish the final objective and ride out with Terry and Clay. Follow the crew back to the clubhouse and enter the final marker to complete the ending.

details_i18n.en: At the prison, speak to Terry before starting the assault: his weapon stock is free during this mission. Bring a rifle and explosives, open the gate and clear each area from cover. Watch raised walkways and rooftop shooters before advancing with the crew. Use the health and armor pickups when needed, then finish the final objective and ride out with Terry and Clay. Follow the crew back to the clubhouse and enter the final marker to complete the ending.
details_i18n.pt: Na prisão, fale com Terry antes de iniciar o ataque: as armas dele são gratuitas nesta missão. Leve um rifle e explosivos, abra o portão e limpe cada área usando cobertura. Observe as passarelas elevadas e os atiradores nos telhados antes de avançar com a equipe. Use as reservas de vida e colete quando necessário, cumpra o objetivo final e saia de moto com Terry e Clay. Siga a equipe de volta ao clube e entre no marcador final para concluir o final.

items.details: Call Angus and select Job after Bad Cop Drop. The ten named theft scenarios are offered in a variable order, so follow the current request rather than assuming this checklist's order is mandatory. Recover the marked motorcycle and deliver it in usable condition; damage reduces payment. For Ex-Display, stealing from the showroom triggers a police response. The full collection requires all ten jobs, not ten deliveries of one freely chosen model.

details_i18n.pt: Ligue para Angus e escolha Job após Bad Cop Drop. Os dez cenários de furto são oferecidos em ordem variável; siga o pedido atual, sem presumir que a ordem deste checklist é obrigatória. Recupere a moto marcada e entregue-a em condições de uso; danos reduzem o pagamento. Em Ex-Display, o furto na loja provoca uma resposta policial. A coleção completa exige os dez trabalhos, não dez entregas de um modelo escolhido livremente.

items.details: This Dirty Laundry job requires more than stealing the Infernus. Take the requested car from the Westdyke property, bring it to the marked mechanic for the surveillance modification and follow the remaining delivery instructions. Preserve the vehicle so the operation can be completed. Stubbs' five phone jobs are offered in variable order; finish each named job rather than counting five repetitions of whichever task appears first.

details_i18n.en: This Dirty Laundry job requires more than stealing the Infernus. Take the requested car from the Westdyke property, bring it to the marked mechanic for the surveillance modification and follow the remaining delivery instructions. Preserve the vehicle so the operation can be completed. Stubbs' five phone jobs are offered in variable order; finish each named job rather than counting five repetitions of whichever task appears first.
details_i18n.pt: Este trabalho Dirty Laundry exige mais que furtar o Infernus. Pegue o carro solicitado no imóvel de Westdyke, leve-o ao mecânico marcado para a modificação de vigilância e siga as instruções de entrega restantes. Preserve o veículo para concluir a operação. Os cinco trabalhos por telefone de Stubbs aparecem em ordem variável; termine cada trabalho nomeado, sem contar cinco repetições do primeiro que surgir.

details_i18n.pt: Comece em um ponto de encontro de Gang Wars após Coming Down e chegue preparado com colete e munição. Leia o objetivo atual: alguns encontros têm grupos parados, outros envolvem motociclistas em movimento ou um transporte protegido que não pode fugir. Use cobertura quando possível e evite explosivos perto da sua equipe. Os 100% nativos exigem vinte e cinco vitórias; as guerras posteriores são opcionais e ficam mais difíceis conforme os inimigos se fortalecem.
